-- class: expand
-- kind: create-table
-- action: ddl

create table "public"."tasks" (
  "id" text not null,
  "tenant_id" uuid not null,
  "title" text not null,
  constraint "tasks_pkey" primary key ("id", "tenant_id")
);

-- class: expand
-- kind: add-constraint
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
alter table "public"."tasks" add constraint "tasks_id_tenant_id_key" unique ("id", "tenant_id");

-- class: expand
-- kind: create-view
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
create view "public"."active_tasks" as SELECT tenant_id,
    title
   FROM tasks;

-- class: expand
-- kind: create-view
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
create view "public"."shared_titles" as SELECT title
   FROM tasks;
